Rong said: "Lord Shen showed me great kindness, and I joined him in this great undertaking; at the first change of fortune to turn my heart—I cannot!"

sentences.zh: 城潰，軍士執以見敬兒，敬兒曰：「邊公何不早來！」

translations.literal: When the city fell apart, soldiers seized him and presented him to Jinger. Jinger said: "Lord Bian, why did you not come sooner!"
translations.idiomatic: When the city collapsed, soldiers seized him and brought him before Jinger. Jinger said: "Lord Bian, why did you not come sooner!"

sentences.zh: 榮曰：「沈公見留守城，不忍委去；

translations.literal: Rong said: "Lord Shen saw that I was left to hold the city, and I could not bear to abandon my post;
translations.idiomatic: Rong said: "Lord Shen left me to hold the city, and I could not bear to abandon my post;

sentences.zh: 本不祈生，何須見問！」

translations.literal: I never hoped to live—why need you question me!"
translations.idiomatic: I never hoped to live—why question me at all!"

sentences.zh: 敬兒曰：「死何難得！」

translations.literal: Jinger said: "Death is not hard to obtain!"
translations.idiomatic: Jinger said: "Death is easy enough to obtain!"

sentences.zh: 命斬之。

translations.literal: He ordered him beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered him beheaded.

sentences.zh: 榮歡笑而去。

translations.literal: Rong went away laughing.
translations.idiomatic: Rong went off laughing.

sentences.zh: 榮客太山程邕之抱榮曰：「與邊公周遊，不忍見邊公死，乞先見殺。」

translations.literal: Rong's retainer Cheng Yinzhi of Taishan embraced Rong and said: "I traveled about with Lord Bian and cannot bear to see Lord Bian die—I beg to be killed first."
translations.idiomatic: Rong's retainer Cheng Yinzhi of Taishan embraced him and said: "I traveled with Lord Bian and cannot bear to see him die—I beg to be killed first."

sentences.zh: 兵人不得行戮，以白敬兒，敬兒曰：「求死甚易，何為不許！」

translations.literal: The soldiers could not carry out the execution and reported it to Jinger. Jinger said: "Seeking death is very easy—why not grant it!"
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers could not bring themselves to execute him and reported this to Jinger. Jinger said: "If he seeks death, that is easily granted—why refuse!"

sentences.zh: 先殺邕之，然後及榮，軍人莫不垂泣。

translations.literal: He first killed Yinzhi, then turned to Rong; not a soldier among them could hold back tears.
translations.idiomatic: He killed Yinzhi first, then Rong; not a soldier present could hold back tears.

sentences.zh: 孫同、宗儼之等皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Sun Tong, Zong Yanzhi, and others all suffered execution.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Tong, Zong Yanzhi, and others were all executed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，解嚴，以侍中柳世隆為尚書右僕射，蕭道成還鎮東府。

translations.literal: On bingzi the martial law was lifted; Palace Attendant Liu Shilong was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Xiao Daocheng returned to garrison the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi martial law was lifted; Palace Attendant Liu Shilong was made right vice director of the masters of writing, and Xiao Daocheng returned to garrison the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以左衛將軍蕭賾為江州刺史，侍中蕭嶷為中領軍。

translations.literal: On dingchou Left Guard General Xiao Ze was made governor of Jiang province, and Palace Attendant Xiao Luan was made Director of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Left Guard General Xiao Ze was made governor of Jiang province, and Palace Attendant Xiao Luan was made director of the central army.

sentences.zh: 二月，庚辰，以尚書左僕射王僧虔為尚書令，右僕射王延之為左僕射。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengchen, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Sengqian was made Director of the Masters of Writing, and Right Vice Director Wang Yanzhi was made Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengchen, left vice director of the masters of writing Wang Sengqian was made director of the masters of writing, and right vice director Wang Yanzhi was made left vice director.

sentences.zh: 癸未，加蕭道成太尉、都督南徐等十六州諸軍事，以衛將軍褚淵為中書監、司空。

translations.literal: On guiwei Xiao Daocheng was promoted to Grand Commandant and made supreme commander of all military affairs in Nanxu and sixteen other provinces. Guard General Chu Yuan was made Director of the Masters of Writing in the Palace and Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Xiao Daocheng was promoted to grand commandant and made supreme commander of military affairs in Nanxu and sixteen other provinces; Guard General Chu Yuan was made director of the palace secretariat and minister of works.

sentences.zh: 道成表送黃鋮。

translations.literal: Daocheng memorialized offering back the yellow battle-axe.
translations.idiomatic: Daocheng memorialized offering back the yellow battle-axe.

sentences.zh: 吏部郎王儉，僧綽之子也，神彩淵曠，好學博聞，少有宰相之志，時論亦推許之。

translations.literal: Wang Jian of the Ministry of Personnel, son of Sengchuo, possessed a lucid and far-reaching spirit; he loved learning and was broadly informed, had from youth aspired to the chancellorship, and contemporary opinion also endorsed him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian of the ministry of personnel, son of Sengchuo, had a lucid and far-reaching spirit; he loved learning, was widely read, had aspired to the chancellorship from youth, and contemporary opinion endorsed him as well.

sentences.zh: 道成以儉為太尉右長史，待遇隆密，事無大小專委之。

translations.literal: Daocheng appointed Jian Grand Commandant's right chief administrator, treated him with extraordinary favor and intimacy, and entrusted to him alone affairs great and small.
translations.idiomatic: Daocheng made Jian his grand commandant's right chief administrator, treated him with extraordinary favor, and entrusted to him alone all affairs great and small.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，魏主如代湯泉；

translations.literal: On dinghai the Wei emperor went to the Dai hot springs;
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Wei emperor went to the Dai hot springs;

sentences.zh: 癸卯，還。

translations.literal: On guimao he returned.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he returned.

sentences.zh: 宕昌王彌機初立。

translations.literal: King Miqi of Dangchang had only recently been installed.
translations.idiomatic: King Miqi of Dangchang had only recently been enthroned.

sentences.zh: 三月，丙子，魏遣使拜彌機征南大將軍、梁、益二州牧、河南公、宕昌王。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingzi, Wei sent envoys to invest Miqi as Grand General Who Conquers the South, governor of Liang and Yi provinces, Duke of Henan, and King of Dangchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingzi, Wei sent envoys to invest Miqi as grand general who conquers the south, governor of Liang and Yi provinces, duke of Henan, and king of Dangchang.

sentences.zh: 黃回不樂在郢州，固求南兗，遂帥部曲輒還；

translations.literal: Huang Hui was unhappy in Ying province and repeatedly requested transfer to Nanxiang; he then led his personal troops and returned on his own authority;
translations.idiomatic: Huang Hui was unhappy in Ying province and repeatedly asked to be transferred to Nanxiang; he then led his personal troops and returned on his own authority;

sentences.zh: 辛卯，改都督南兗等五州諸軍事、南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinmao he was reassigned as commander-in-chief of military affairs in Nanxiang and five other provinces and governor of Nanxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he was reassigned as commander-in-chief of military affairs in Nanxiang and five other provinces and as governor of Nanxiang.

sentences.zh: 初，王蘊去湘州，湘州刺史南陽王翽未之鎮，長沙內史庾佩玉行府事。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Wang Yun left Xiang province, Xiang governor Prince Hui of Nanyang had not yet gone to his post; Changsha's prefect Yu Peiyu administered the governor's office in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Wang Yun left Xiang province, Xiang governor Prince Hui of Nanyang had not yet taken up his post; Changsha prefect Yu Peiyu administered the governor's office in his stead.

sentences.zh: 翽先遣中兵參軍韓幼宗將兵戍湘州，與佩玉不相能。

translations.literal: Hui had previously sent Central Army Staff Officer Han Youzong to lead troops garrisoning Xiang province; he and Peiyu did not get along.
translations.idiomatic: Hui had previously sent central army staff officer Han Youzong to garrison Xiang province with troops; he and Peiyu could not get along.

sentences.zh: 及沈攸之反，兩人互相疑，佩玉襲殺幼宗。

translations.literal: When Shen Youzhi rebelled, the two mutually suspected each other, and Peiyu launched a surprise attack that killed Youzong.
translations.idiomatic: When Shen Youzhi rebelled, the two came to suspect each other, and Peiyu launched a surprise attack and killed Youzong.

sentences.zh: 黃回至郢州，遣輔國將軍任候伯行湘州事；

translations.literal: When Huang Hui reached Ying province, he dispatched Assistant General Ren Houbo to administer Xiang province affairs;
translations.idiomatic: When Huang Hui reached Ying province, he sent assistant general Ren Houbo to administer Xiang province affairs;

sentences.zh: 候伯輒殺佩玉，冀以自免。

translations.literal: Houbo immediately killed Peiyu, hoping thereby to escape blame himself.
translations.idiomatic: Houbo immediately killed Peiyu, hoping thereby to clear himself.

sentences.zh: 湘州刺史呂安國之鎮，蕭道成使安國誅候伯。

translations.literal: When Xiang governor Lü Anguo arrived at his post, Xiao Daocheng had Anguo execute Houbo.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiang governor Lü Anguo arrived to take up his post, Xiao Daocheng had Anguo execute Houbo.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，甲申，魏主如崞山；

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiashen the Wei emperor went to Guo Mountain;
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on jiashen the Wei emperor went to Guo Mountain;

sentences.zh: 丁亥，還。

translations.literal: On dinghai he returned.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he returned.

sentences.zh: 蕭道成以黃回終為禍亂；

translations.literal: Xiao Daocheng judged that Huang Hui would in the end bring disaster and turmoil;
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Daocheng judged that Huang Hui would in the end bring disaster and turmoil;

sentences.zh: 回有部曲數千人，欲遣收，恐為亂。

translations.literal: Hui had several thousand personal troops; to dispatch troops to seize them might provoke rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Hui had several thousand personal troops; to send men to seize them might provoke rebellion.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，召回入東府。

translations.literal: On xinmao he summoned Hui to enter the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he summoned Hui to the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 至，停外齋，使桓康將數十人，數回罪而殺之，並其子竟陵相僧念。

translations.literal: When Hui arrived, he was lodged in the outer quarters. Xiao Daocheng sent Huan Kang with several dozen men to enumerate Hui's crimes and kill him, along with his son Sengnian, chief administrator of Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: When Hui arrived, he was lodged in the outer quarters. Daocheng sent Huan Kang with several dozen men to enumerate Hui's crimes and kill him, along with his son Sengnian, chief administrator of Jingling.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以淮南、宣城二郡太守蕭映行南兗州事，仍以其弟晃代之。

translations.literal: On jiawu the magistrate of Huainan and Xuancheng commanderies Xiao Ying was appointed to administer Nanxiang affairs in the interim, while his younger brother Huang was substituted in his former post.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Xiao Ying, magistrate of Huainan and Xuancheng commanderies, was appointed to administer Nanxiang affairs in the interim, while his younger brother Huang replaced him in his former post.

sentences.zh: 五月，魏禁皇族、貴戚及士民之家不顧氏族，下與非類婚偶；

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Wei forbade members of the imperial clan, noble families, and gentry and common households from disregarding their lineage and marrying downward with unworthy matches;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Wei forbade members of the imperial clan, noble families, and gentry and common households from disregarding their lineage and marrying beneath their station;

sentences.zh: 犯者以違制論。

translations.literal: Violators were prosecuted under the statute on violating imperial regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Violators were prosecuted under the statute on violating imperial regulations.

sentences.zh: 魏主與太后臨虎圈，有虎逸，登閣道，幾至御座，侍衛皆驚靡；

translations.literal: The Wei emperor and the empress dowager visited the tiger enclosure; a tiger broke loose, climbed the gallery path, and nearly reached the imperial seat—all the guards were stricken with terror;
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor and the empress dowager visited the tiger enclosure; a tiger broke loose, climbed the gallery path, and nearly reached the imperial seat, and all the guards were stricken with terror;

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書王叡執戟御之，太后稱以為忠，親任愈重。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Wang Rui seized a halberd and repelled it. The empress dowager praised this as loyalty, and her personal trust in him grew ever greater.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of personnel Wang Rui seized a halberd and drove it back. The empress dowager praised this as loyalty, and her personal trust in him grew ever greater.

sentences.zh: 六月，丁酉，以輔國將軍楊文弘為北秦州刺史、武都王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingyou Assistant General Yang Wenhong was made governor of North Qin province and King of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingyou assistant general Yang Wenhong was made governor of North Qin province and king of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 庚子，魏皇叔若卒。

translations.literal: On gengzi the Wei imperial uncle Ruo died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Wei imperial uncle Ruo died.

sentences.zh: 蕭道成以大明以來，公私奢侈，秋，八月，奏罷御府，省二尚方雕飾器玩；

translations.literal: Xiao Daocheng, considering that since the Daming era public and private life had grown extravagantly wasteful, in autumn, the eighth month, memorialized abolishing the imperial workshops and reducing the two ateliers' ornamental carved and decorated wares;
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Daocheng, considering that since the Daming era public and private life had grown extravagantly wasteful, in autumn, the eighth month, memorialized abolishing the imperial workshops and reducing the ornamental carved wares of the two ateliers;

sentences.zh: 辛卯，又奏禁民間華偽雜事，凡十七條。

translations.literal: On xinmao he further memorialized forbidding gaudy and fraudulent diversions among the people—seventeen articles in all.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he further memorialized forbidding gaudy and fraudulent diversions among the people—seventeen articles in all.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以蕭賾為領軍將軍，蕭嶷為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On yiwei Xiao Ze was made Director of the Army and Xiao Luan was made governor of Jiang province.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Xiao Ze was made director of the army and Xiao Luan was made governor of Jiang province.

sentences.zh: 九月，乙巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yisi the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yisi the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 蕭道成欲引時賢參贊大業，夜，召驃騎長史謝朏，屏人與語，久之，朏無言；

translations.literal: Xiao Daocheng wished to draw men of talent of the age to share in the great enterprise. At night he summoned Chief Administrator of the Rapid Steeds Xie Tiao, dismissed attendants, and spoke with him at length—but Tiao said nothing;
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Daocheng wished to draw men of talent of the age to share in the great enterprise. At night he summoned chief administrator of the rapid steeds Xie Tiao, dismissed attendants, and spoke with him at length—but Tiao said nothing;

sentences.zh: 唯二小兒捉燭，道成慮朏難之，仍取燭遣兒，朏又無言；

translations.literal: only two young boys held candles; Daocheng, fearing Tiao found it burdensome, took the candles and sent the boys away—yet Tiao still said nothing;
translations.idiomatic: only two young boys held candles; Daocheng, fearing Tiao found it burdensome, took the candles and sent the boys away—yet Tiao still said nothing;

sentences.zh: 道成乃呼左右。

translations.literal: Daocheng then called for attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Daocheng then called for attendants.

sentences.zh: 朏，莊之子也。

translations.literal: Tiao was the son of Zhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Tiao was the son of Zhuang.

sentences.zh: 太尉右長史王儉知其指，它日，請間言於道成曰：「功高不賞，古今非一。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant's right chief administrator Wang Jian understood his intent. Another day he requested a private audience and said to Daocheng: "Merit too high to reward is not a thing unique to our age.
translations.idiomatic: Grand commandant's right chief administrator Wang Jian understood his intent. Another day he requested a private audience and said to Daocheng: "Merit too high to reward is not a thing unique to our age.

sentences.zh: 以公今日位地，欲終北面，可乎？」

translations.literal: Given your present position and standing, do you suppose you can remain facing north as minister to the end?"
translations.idiomatic: Given your present position and standing, do you suppose you can remain facing north as minister to the end?"

sentences.zh: 道成正色裁之，而神采內和。

translations.literal: Daocheng sternly checked him in word, yet inwardly his expression was composed.
translations.idiomatic: Daocheng sternly checked him in word, yet inwardly his expression was composed.

sentences.zh: 儉因曰：「儉蒙公殊眄，所以吐所難吐；

translations.literal: Jian then said: "Jian has received your extraordinary favor—that is why I speak what is hard to speak;
translations.idiomatic: Jian then said: "I have received your extraordinary favor—that is why I speak what is hard to speak;

sentences.zh: 何賜拒之深！

translations.literal: why do you grant me such deep refusal!
translations.idiomatic: why do you meet me with such deep refusal!

sentences.zh: 宋氏失德，非公豈復寧濟！

translations.literal: The Song house has lost its virtue—without you, who could restore quiet and order!
translations.idiomatic: The Song house has lost its virtue—without you, who could restore quiet and order!

sentences.zh: 但人情澆薄，不能持久；

translations.literal: But men's hearts run thin and cannot long endure;
translations.idiomatic: But men's hearts run thin and cannot long endure;

sentences.zh: 公若小復推遷，則人望去矣。

translations.literal: if you defer and yield even a little, men's hopes will slip away.
translations.idiomatic: if you defer and yield even a little, men's hopes will slip away.

sentences.zh: 豈唯大業永淪，七尺亦不可得保。」

translations.literal: Not only will the great enterprise be lost forever—you yourself may not preserve even your own frame."
translations.idiomatic: Not only will the great enterprise be lost forever—you yourself may not preserve even your own frame."

sentences.zh: 道成曰：「卿言不無理。」

translations.literal: Daocheng said: "Your words are not without reason."
translations.idiomatic: Daocheng said: "Your words are not without reason."

sentences.zh: 儉曰：「公今名位，故是經常宰相，宜禮絕群後，微示變革。

translations.literal: Jian said: "Your present title and rank are still those of an ordinary chancellor; you ought to set ritual above all others and show in small things that change is at hand.
translations.idiomatic: Jian said: "Your present title and rank are still those of an ordinary chancellor; you ought to set ritual above all others and show in small things that change is at hand.

sentences.zh: 當先令褚公知之，儉請銜命。」

translations.literal: Chu ought to be informed first—I ask to bear the mission."
translations.idiomatic: Lord Chu ought to be informed first—I ask to bear the mission."

sentences.zh: 道成曰：「我當自往。」

translations.literal: Daocheng said: "I shall go myself."
translations.idiomatic: Daocheng said: "I shall go myself."

sentences.zh: 經少日，道成自造褚淵，款言移晷，乃謂曰：「我夢應得官。」

translations.literal: After a few days Daocheng personally visited Chu Yuan; they conversed at ease until the day had moved well on, and then he said: "In a dream I should receive office."
translations.idiomatic: After a few days Daocheng personally visited Chu Yuan; they conversed at ease until the day had moved well on, and then he said: "In a dream I should receive office."

sentences.zh: 淵曰：「今授始爾，恐一二年間未容便移；

translations.literal: Yuan said: "Your appointment has only just begun; I fear that within a year or two it will not yet be permissible to shift positions;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan said: "Your appointment has only just begun; I fear that within a year or two it will not yet be permissible to shift positions;

sentences.zh: 且吉夢未必應在旦夕。」

translations.literal: besides, an auspicious dream need not be fulfilled overnight."
translations.idiomatic: besides, an auspicious dream need not be fulfilled overnight."

sentences.zh: 道成還，以告儉。

translations.literal: Daocheng returned and told Jian.
translations.idiomatic: Daocheng returned and told Jian.

sentences.zh: 儉曰：「褚是未達理耳。」

translations.literal: Jian said: "Chu simply does not grasp the point."
translations.idiomatic: Jian said: "Chu simply does not grasp the point."

sentences.zh: 儉乃唱議加道成太傅，假黃鉞，使中書舍人虞整作詔。

translations.literal: Jian then openly proposed advancing Daocheng to Grand Tutor with the yellow battle-axe in commission, and had Palace Secretariat Attendant Yu Zheng draft the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Jian then openly proposed advancing Daocheng to grand tutor with commission of the yellow battle-axe, and had palace secretariat attendant Yu Zheng draft the edict.

sentences.zh: 道成所親任遐曰：「此大事，應報褚公。」

translations.literal: Daocheng's close associate Ren Xia said: "This great affair ought to be reported to Lord Chu."
translations.idiomatic: Daocheng's close associate Ren Xia said: "This great affair ought to be reported to Lord Chu."

sentences.zh: 道成曰：「褚公不從，奈何？」

translations.literal: Daocheng said: "What if Lord Chu will not consent?"
translations.idiomatic: Daocheng said: "What if Lord Chu will not consent?"

sentences.zh: 遐曰：「彥回惜身保妻子，非有奇才異節，遐能制之。」

translations.literal: Xia said: "Yanhui cherishes his life and protects wife and children—he has no exceptional talent or steadfast integrity. Xia can control him."
translations.idiomatic: Xia said: "Yanhui cherishes his life and protects wife and children—he has no exceptional talent or steadfast integrity. I can control him."

sentences.zh: 淵果無違異。

translations.literal: Yuan indeed offered no opposition.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan indeed offered no opposition.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔進道成假黃鉞、大都督中外諸軍事、太傅、領揚州牧，劍履上殿，入朝不趨，贊拜不名，使持節、太尉、驃騎大將軍、錄尚書、南徐州刺史如故。

translations.literal: On bingwu an edict advanced Daocheng with commission of the yellow battle-axe, supreme command of all military affairs at home and abroad, Grand Tutor, and concurrent governor of Yang province, with sword and shoes in the palace, no need to quicken pace when entering court, no naming when attending in support, acting on imperial authority—the titles Grand Commandant, Grand General of the Rapid Steeds, controller of the Masters of Writing, and governor of South Xu province remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu an edict advanced Daocheng with commission of the yellow battle-axe, supreme command of all military affairs at home and abroad, grand tutor, and concurrent governor of Yang province, with sword and shoes in the palace, no need to quicken pace when entering court, no naming when attending in support, and acting on imperial authority—the titles grand commandant, grand general of the rapid steeds, controller of the masters of writing, and governor of South Xu province remaining as before.

sentences.zh: 道成固辭殊禮。

translations.literal: Daocheng firmly declined the extraordinary honors.
translations.idiomatic: Daocheng firmly declined the extraordinary honors.

sentences.zh: 以揚州刺史晉熙王燮為司徒。

translations.literal: Prince Xie of Jinxi was made Minister over the Masses while serving as governor of Yang province.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xie of Jinxi was made minister over the masses while serving as governor of Yang province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太傅道成以蕭映為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wushen Grand Tutor Daocheng appointed Xiao Ying governor of South Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen grand tutor Daocheng appointed Xiao Ying governor of South Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，丁丑，以蕭晃為豫州剌史。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on dingchou, Xiao Huang was made governor of Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on dingchou, Xiao Huang was made governor of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，獲孫曇瓘，殺之。

translations.literal: On jimao Sun Tanqiong was captured and killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Sun Tanqiong was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 魏員外散騎常侍鄭羲來聘。

translations.literal: The Wei Outer Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Valiant Cavalry Zheng Xi came on a mission of courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei outer attendant-in-ordinary of the valiant cavalry Zheng Xi came on a diplomatic mission.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，立皇后謝氏。

translations.literal: On renyin Lady Xie was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Lady Xie was made empress.

sentences.zh: 後，莊之孫也。

translations.literal: The empress was a granddaughter of Zhuang.
translations.idiomatic: She was a granddaughter of Zhuang.

sentences.zh: 十一月，癸亥，臨澧侯劉晃坐謀反，與其黨皆伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guihai, Marquis Liu Huang of Linli was charged with plotting rebellion; he and his faction were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guihai, Marquis Liu Huang of Linli was charged with treason; he and his followers were all executed.

sentences.zh: 晃，秉之從子也。

translations.literal: Huang was a nephew of Bing.
translations.idiomatic: Huang was a nephew of Liu Bing.

sentences.zh: 甲子，徙南陽王翽為隨郡王。

translations.literal: On jiazi Prince Hui of Nanyang was moved to be Prince of Suijun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Prince Hui of Nanyang was reassigned as prince of Sui commandery.

sentences.zh: 魏馮太后忌青州刺史南郡王李惠，誣雲惠將南叛；

translations.literal: The Wei Empress Dowager Feng resented Li Hui, Prince of Nanjun, governor of Qingzhou, and slandered him, saying Hui was about to rebel in the south;
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Wei empress dowager Feng resented Li Hui, prince of Nanjun and governor of Qingzhou, and slandered him, claiming he was about to rebel in the south;

sentences.zh: 十二月，癸巳，誅惠及妻並其子弟。

translations.literal: in the twelfth month, on guisi, Hui, his wife, and his sons and younger brothers were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: in the twelfth month, on guisi, Hui, his wife, and his sons and younger brothers were executed.

sentences.zh: 太后以猜嫌所夷滅者十餘家，而惠所歷皆有善政，魏人尤冤惜之。

translations.literal: Through suspicion the empress dowager had exterminated more than ten clans; yet wherever Hui had served there had been good government, and the people of Wei especially lamented him as wronged.
translations.idiomatic: Through suspicion she had destroyed more than ten clans; yet wherever Hui had served he had governed well, and the people of Wei especially mourned him as a wrongful victim.

sentences.zh: 尚書令王僧虔奏以「朝廷禮樂，多違正典。

translations.literal: Master of Writing Wang Sengqian memorialized: "The court's ritual and music largely depart from the canonical standards.
translations.idiomatic: Master of writing Wang Sengqian memorialized: "The court's ritual and music largely depart from canonical standards.

sentences.zh: 大明中即以宮縣合和鞞拂，節數雖會，慮乖雅體。

translations.literal: In the Daming era palace bells were already combined with drums and flappers; though the beats matched in number, I fear they violate refined form.
translations.idiomatic: In the Daming era palace bells were already combined with drums and flappers; though the counts matched, I fear the result violates refined propriety.

sentences.zh: 又，今之清商，實由銅爵，三祖風流，遺音盈耳，京、洛相高，江左彌貴，中庸和雅，莫近於斯。

translations.literal: Moreover, today's pure shang music in fact derives from the Bronze Bird Terrace; the three ancestors' elegant legacy fills the ear; Jing and Luo prized it, and the lands south of the Yangtze hold it still dearer—nothing approaches it in balanced harmony and refinement.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, today's pure shang music derives from the Bronze Bird Terrace; the elegant legacy of the three Wei emperors still fills the ear. Luoyang prized it, and the south of the Yangtze holds it dearer still—nothing equals its balanced harmony and refinement.

sentences.zh: 而情變聽移，稍復銷落，十數年間，亡者將半，民間競造新聲雜曲，煩淫無極，宜命有司悉加補綴。」

translations.literal: Yet as tastes shift and hearing changes, it has gradually declined; within a dozen years nearly half is lost, while the common people vie to compose new tunes and mixed airs, licentious beyond measure—it is fitting to order the relevant offices to restore and patch them all."
translations.idiomatic: Yet as tastes shift it has gradually declined; within a dozen years nearly half is lost, while commoners vie to compose new tunes and mixed airs, licentious beyond measure. The relevant offices should be ordered to restore and preserve them all."

sentences.zh: 朝廷從之。

translations.literal: The court followed his advice.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏懷州刺史高允以老疾告歸鄉里，尋復以安車征至平城，拜鎮軍大將軍、中書監；

translations.literal: That year, Gao Yun, governor of Huaizhou in Wei, reported old age and illness and asked to return to his home village; soon he was summoned again by comfort carriage to Pingcheng and appointed Grand General Who Pacifies the Army and Supervisor of the Masters of Writing;
translations.idiomatic: That year Gao Yun, Northern Wei governor of Huaizhou, cited old age and illness and asked to retire home; soon he was summoned again by comfort carriage to Pingcheng and made pacification-army grand general and supervisor of the masters of writing;

sentences.zh: 固辭，不許。

translations.literal: he firmly declined but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: he firmly declined but was not allowed to refuse.

sentences.zh: 乘車入殿，朝賀不拜。

translations.literal: He entered the hall in his carriage and did not bow when offering court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the hall in his carriage and did not bow when offering congratulations at court.
